title: Oyedele calls for public listings of NNPC and NLNG
description: Nairametrics reports that Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele advocated listing NNPC Limited and Nigeria LNG to improve transparency and broaden public participation in state-owned assets.
content:
Nairametrics reports that Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele advocated listing NNPC Limited and Nigeria LNG to improve transparency and broaden public participation in state-owned assets.

He made the case at the National Capital Market Conference in Abuja. The proposal forms part of a wider discussion about expanding Nigeria’s capital markets; the report does not establish a completed listing or an IPO date.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.

title: Nigerian equities fall as industrial and bank shares retreat
description: The Nigerian Exchange ended October 19 lower, according to Nairametrics. Its report put the decline in market capitalisation at N1.47 trillion, with the All-Share Index down 0.91%.
content:
The Nigerian Exchange ended October 19 lower, according to Nairametrics. Its report put the decline in market capitalisation at N1.47 trillion, with the All-Share Index down 0.91%.

Declines in Dangote Cement and several banking shares contributed to the session’s losses. These figures describe one historical trading session and are not a forecast of future market performance.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.

title: Nigeria introduces capital-market development plan through 2036
description: Nigeria unveiled a capital-market roadmap targeting N750 trillion by 2036, Nairametrics reports. The plan aims to broaden investment participation and increase long-term funding for businesses and infrastructure.
content:
Nigeria unveiled a capital-market roadmap targeting N750 trillion by 2036, Nairametrics reports. The plan aims to broaden investment participation and increase long-term funding for businesses and infrastructure.

The report distinguishes the master plan’s target from Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele’s separate proposal for a US$1 trillion market. Both are policy ambitions rather than achieved market values.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.

title: Kano lawmakers reduce spending plan after revenue shortfall
description: Nairametrics reports that Kano’s legislature approved a reduction of about N276 billion in the state’s 2026 budget after federation-account revenue fell short of its spending assumptions.
content:
Nairametrics reports that Kano’s legislature approved a reduction of about N276 billion in the state’s 2026 budget after federation-account revenue fell short of its spending assumptions.

The revised plan seeks to align expenditure with available funds. The report says capital spending was reduced, while noting that officials had not identified which individual projects might be affected.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.

title: NAFDAC reports suspected counterfeit-drinks operation in Aba
description: NAFDAC said an enforcement operation uncovered a suspected counterfeit-alcohol facility in Aba, Abia State, according to Nairametrics. The agency valued equipment and materials at more than N500 million.
content:
NAFDAC said an enforcement operation uncovered a suspected counterfeit-alcohol facility in Aba, Abia State, according to Nairametrics. The agency valued equipment and materials at more than N500 million.

The report attributes the allegations to the regulator’s statement. It says officials found production and packaging materials and urged the public to report suspected illegal manufacturing through official channels. The allegations are not a court finding.

title: Mortgage bank reports housing-finance approvals for 2025
description: The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria said it approved over N208 billion in housing-related loans during 2025, Nairametrics reports. The bank also reported financing 6,911 affordable housing units that year.
content:
The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria said it approved over N208 billion in housing-related loans during 2025, Nairametrics reports. The bank also reported financing 6,911 affordable housing units that year.

The figures were disclosed at an October 19, 2026 event in Abuja. They refer to the bank’s reported 2025 activity, rather than loans issued on the publication date. The report also discusses initiatives for Nigerians living abroad.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.

title: Education ministry says recruitment-waiver process remains in force
description: Nigeria’s education ministry clarified that federal tertiary institutions must continue following recruitment-waiver procedures, according to Nairametrics. The statement followed conflicting interpretations of remarks at a university convocation.
content:
Nigeria’s education ministry clarified that federal tertiary institutions must continue following recruitment-waiver procedures, according to Nairametrics. The statement followed conflicting interpretations of remarks at a university convocation.

The ministry outlined the roles of the civil-service head and the committee considering recruitment requests. The clarification directs institutions to use existing approval arrangements rather than treating the earlier remarks as an unconditional exemption.

title: NASA’s simulated Mars crew reaches a year in isolation
description: NASA says four volunteers in its second CHAPEA simulated Mars mission have completed a year inside a Houston habitat. Researchers are studying health, performance and the demands of long-duration exploration.
content:
NASA says four volunteers in its second CHAPEA simulated Mars mission have completed a year inside a Houston habitat. Researchers are studying health, performance and the demands of long-duration exploration.

The crew entered the habitat on October 19, 2025. NASA’s October 19, 2026 update describes preparations for their planned October 31 exit and follow-up evaluations. The experiment takes place on Earth, not on Mars.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.

title: NASA engineers streamline rocket shock and vibration modelling
description: NASA reports that engineers at Kennedy Space Center have standardised a modelling workflow to assess shock and vibration affecting rockets and spacecraft. The approach helps identify structural risks before flight.
content:
NASA reports that engineers at Kennedy Space Center have standardised a modelling workflow to assess shock and vibration affecting rockets and spacecraft. The approach helps identify structural risks before flight.

The agency describes using finite-element modelling and shared templates to analyse launch environments. NASA says the workflow has helped engineers investigate testing requirements and reduce time spent obtaining or rebuilding specialised analyses.

Original summary by AbokiNews. Read the linked source for the full report.
